Hace exactamente un año, la senadora Paloma Valencia celebraba con entusiasmo el hundimiento de la reforma laboral. Nos advertía, con tono apocalíptico, que sería un desastre total: inflación descontrolada, destrucción masiva de empleo y el fin de las empresas. Mentira. La realidad demostró lo contrario. La inflación no se disparó; al contrario, se mantuvo controlada y cerró 2025 en niveles manejables. El desempleo, lejos de explotar, bajó de forma histórica: cerró el año en 8,9%, la tasa más baja en más de dos décadas según el DANE. Se crearon cientos de miles de nuevos puestos de trabajo, la ocupación subió y las empresas, en lugar de quebrar, están vendiendo más, contratando más y creciendo. ¿Por qué? Porque cuando la gente tiene más plata en el bolsillo —gracias a más empleo y mejores ingresos—, compra más. Es economía básica: mayor consumo impulsa el comercio, los servicios y la producción. El PIB creció 2,6% en 2025, impulsado precisamente por la demanda interna y el dinamismo de los hogares. No se coman el cuento. Los hechos hablan más fuerte que los discursos de campaña. Colombia sigue adelante, con más gente trabajando y más economía circulando. Punto. #CepedaEnPrimeraVuelta Video

1. Pakistan has offered to mediate & resolve the war in Iran. While Trump has shared Shehbaz Sharif’s post on the offer to host talks, there has been no official word from Iran. #CutTheClutter looks at the complexities & hypocrisies as Pakistan tries to play mediator & why India should keep away. It also details what Pakistan stands to gain from these negotiations. 2. These talks are likely to take place in Islamabad. Turkey was being considered as a venue, but Pakistan fits the bill better. Why? · It’s a large Muslim state with the second-largest Shia population · It has a big army & nukes · Pakistan has a special relationship with the Arabs & close ties with Iran · Its military establishment has deep ties with US · It’s a major non-NATO ally 3. Now, while Pakistan says it is happy to play mediators, Saudi Arabia is reported to be pushing the US to continue fighting. MBS wants the Iranian threat to end for good. And here’s the contradiction — Pakistan is a treaty-bound protector of Saudi Arabia. 4. Here’s some more: So, Pakistan hopes to host talks between Iran, US & its Arab Muslim brothers. But, at the same time, it is bombing Muslim Afghanistan. And, while Pakistan wants to mediate there, Iran has offered to mediate between Iran & Pakistan. This looks like a very complicated situation, not one India should get into. 5. This brings me to a little bit of opinion, something I rarely share on CTC. In India, there’s been a lot of FOMO about not being at that talks table. But, look at the stakeholders. On one side are all our strategic partners — 6 Middle East nations, Israel & US. For us to be neutral was going to be tough. 6. Pakistan is not neutral either but it is a neighbour. And, it’s a country that can play the role of a client state much more than India has ever done. This is not a competition India needs to get into. India has a deep strategic partnership with Israel. Neither Pakistan nor Iran recognises Israel. How can one expect India to walk into this mess? 7. NITI Aayog, in collaboration with the International Centre for Integrated Mountain Development (ICIMOD), convened a National Consultation on “Incentive Mechanisms for Springshed Management” on 24 March 2026 in New Delhi. Chaired by Dr. V.K. Saraswat, Member, NITI Aayog and Chairperson, Himalayan States Regional Council (HSRC), with key participation from Ms. Nameeta Prasad, Joint Secretary and Head of Mountain Division, MoEFCC, and Dr. Pema Gyamtsho, Director General, ICIMOD, the consultation brought together over 60 experts from Central Ministries, State Governments, Development Finance Institutions, Civil Society Organisations, and Research Institutions. The consultation focused on designing a national incentive architecture for rejuvenating Himalayan springs, a vital water source supporting millions across the Indian Himalayan Region. It was structured in two segments: the first highlighted best practices from Himalayan States, covering spring status, governance frameworks, resource availability, and key learnings. The second featured thematic group discussions on Financial & Fiscal, Institutional & Governance, Community & Livelihood, and Ecosystem & Knowledge incentives, aimed at advancing a shift from fragmented schemes to a mission-oriented, convergence-driven framework. #PMOIndia #NITIAayog #ICIMOD #SpringshedManagement #WaterSecurity #HimalayanSprings #ClimateResilience #ViksitBharat2047 #ClimateAction

The future USS Harvey C. Barnum Jr. (DDG 124) arrived at its homeport of Naval Station Norfolk on March 20, ahead of its commissioning ceremony. The warship’s namesake, retired U.S. Marine Corps Col. Harvey Curtiss "Barney" Barnum Jr., a Medal of Honor recipient, welcomed the warship and its crew to Norfolk. On Dec. 18, 1965, then-1st Lt. Barnum assumed command of his company after the commander was mortally wounded. With two armed helicopters under his control, he moved fearlessly through deadly fire to lead air attacks against the enemy's well-entrenched positions while directing one platoon in a successful counterattack on the key positions. Having cleared a small area, he requested and directed the landing of two transport helicopters to evacuate the deceased and wounded. He then assisted in seizing the battalion's objective. He is among the few living namesakes to witness his warship's commissioning. #NationalMedalOfHonorDay 📸 MCSA Jackson C. Rott

Today, at a special meeting of the Permanent Council, we honored the victims of slavery and the transatlantic slave trade, one of the gravest tragedies in human history. We remember the millions of men, women, and children whose lives were stolen, and we recognize the enduring impact of this atrocity on our societies. Within the framework of the Ninth Inter-American Week for People of African Descent in the Americas, being celebrated at the OAS this week, we reaffirm our unwavering commitment to confronting the legacy of slavery, racism, and discrimination. This is not only a moment of remembrance, but also a call to action to dismantle structural inequalities and ensure full inclusion, justice, and respect for the rights of people of African descent across the hemisphere. The OAS will continue to work alongside member states, civil society, and leaders of African descent to promote equity, strengthen democratic institutions, and advance policies that close historical gaps. Honoring this memory means building a future rooted in dignity, equality, and opportunity for all. Video

कांदा प्रश्न कायमस्वरूपी निकाली काढण्यासाठी दीर्घकालीन पर्यायांची अंमलबजावणी मुख्यमंत्री देवेंद्र फडणवीस यांच्या अध्यक्षतेखाली आज विधान भवन, मुंबई येथे कांदा उत्पादक शेतकऱ्यांच्या प्रश्नांसंदर्भात बैठक पार पडली. कांदा प्रश्नावर कायमस्वरुपी तोडगा काढण्याची गरज आहे. यासाठी कृषी विभागाचे अपर मुख्य सचिव, वित्त विभागाचे अपर मुख्य सचिव आणि पणन विभागाचे सचिव यांची समिती स्थापन करण्यात येईल. या समितीने शेतकऱ्यांना तातडीने करता येणाऱ्या उपायोजना सुचवाव्यात तसेच कांदा प्रश्न कायमस्वरूपी निकाली काढण्यासाठी यंत्रणांनी दीर्घकालीन पर्यायांची अंमलबजावणी करावी, असे निर्देश मुख्यमंत्री देवेंद्र फडणवीस यांनी दिले. मुख्यमंत्री फडणवीस म्हणाले, कांदा व्यापारातील गैरप्रकार रोखण्यासाठी आणि कांद्याची निर्यात वाढवून दर स्थिर ठेवण्यासाठी केंद्र शासनाशी समन्वय साधला जाणार आहे. यासाठी केंद्रीय वाणिज्य मंत्री पीयूष गोयल यांच्यासोबत लवकरच बैठक घेण्यात येणार आहे. नाशिक, पुणे, अहिल्यानगर व सोलापूर या प्रमुख जिल्ह्यांत 'क्रॉप डायव्हर्सिफिकेशन'ची शक्यता पडताळण्याचे निर्देश समितीला मुख्यमंत्री फडणवीस यांनी दिले. येणाऱ्या खरीप हंगामातच या प्रयोगाची अंमलबजावणी करण्यावर भर देत, कांद्यामध्येही विविध वाणांची निवड, उत्पादन क्षमता आणि बाजारपेठेच्या गरजा यांचा अभ्यास करून ‘क्रॉप डायव्हर्सिफिकेशन’ करणे आवश्यक असल्याचे मुख्यमंत्री फडणवीस यांनी स्पष्ट केले. शेतकऱ्यांना कांदा पिकापेक्षा अधिक उत्पन्न देणाऱ्या पर्यायी पिकांकडे वळविणे आवश्यक आहे. पुढील दोन ते तीन वर्षांमध्ये अशी कार्यपद्धती राबविल्यास कांद्याचे उत्पादन आणि पुरवठा अधिक संतुलित होऊन शेतकऱ्यांना त्याचा थेट फायदा होईल. या समितीने सर्व परिस्थितीचा आढावा घेऊन अल्पकालीन उपायोजना सुचवाव्यात, असे निर्देशही मुख्यमंत्री फडणवीस यांनी दिले. यावेळी उपमुख्यमंत्री सुनेत्रा अजित पवार, मंत्री गिरीष महाजन, मंत्री राधाकृष्ण विखे पाटील, मंत्री जयकुमार रावल, मंत्री दत्तात्रय भरणे, मंत्री नरहरी झिरवाळ, मंत्री दादाजी भुसे, मंत्री छगन भुजबळ व वरिष्ठ अधिकारी उपस्थित होते. @Dev_Fadnavis @SunetraA_Pawar @girishdmahajan @RVikhePatil @JaykumarRawal @bharanemamaNCP @Narhari_Zirwal @dadajibhuse @DrRahulAher #Maharashtra #DevendraFadnavis #OnionFarmers Video

Each March, mushers and sled dogs prepare to travel one of Alaska’s most historic winter routes during the Iditarod Trail Sled Dog Race. The trail itself isn’t permanent. It takes shape each winter. The depth, density, and timing of snowpack determine when a winter trail can safely take shape across public lands, including sections managed by the Bureau of Land Management. Small shifts in temperature can mean thinner snow at lower elevations or earlier melt in key sections. In fact, low snow has forced the Iditarod to move its starting location in 2003, 2015, 2017, and again in 2025. USGS scientists track snow conditions from satellites and in the field to better understand how Alaska’s winter landscape changes from year to year. By race day, winter has already built the trail across Alaska’s public lands. 📷: Landsat 9 image of Anchorage, Alaska, captured November 20, 2021. @BLMNational @BLMAlaska

The LiteLLM supply chain attack is big shenanigans. I have to explain the whole thingie though so you can get the full context of the shenanigans. TeamPCP (the people who probably did it) is unironically swinging a big ass fuck off baseball bat, they're swinging for the moon. tl;dr see picture of cat as summary I also want to preface this with I DID NOT PERFORM THIS ANALYSIS. I almost never do open-source solutions malware stuff and this is also more in the line of work with DFIR (Digital Forensics and Incident Response). This summary comes from various peers and colleagues of mine who have been discussing TeamPCP the past couple of days. DFIR nerds I sourced: - @ramimacisabird - @InsiderPhD Non DFIR nerds I sourced: - @IceSolst - @IntCyberDigest Yeah, so pretty much this group of nerds named TeamPCP bamboozled an open-source security product called Trivy. TeamPCP sent a pull request on GitHub but did it with "pull_request_target". Normally a pull request isn't a big deal. Nerds do it all the time. "pull_request_target" though is designed to copy secrets, tokens, etc. pull_request_target is a legit thing. People do it all the time. It should only be performed by people you trust. TeamPCP impersonated a legitimate GitHub contributor. Trivy was caught slippin'. When TeamPCP did pull_request_target they stole access tokens to a place called Aqua Security. Aqua Security was like, "lol gosh dang it" and did what you were supposed to do. They rotated access tokens and passwords and stuff. However, Aqua made an oopsie and forgot to rotate the stuff for one of their automation bots. Once TeamPCP had access they injected malicious code which steal environment variables, SSH keys, cloud credentials, cryptotokens, etc into three things. - Trivy - Trivy GitHub actions - Trivy Docker stuff As is tradition, once TeamPCP put malware into Trivy stuff, anyone who did anything with Trivy was given malware. TeamPCP got a metric poop ton of stolen data and began using it to move to NPM projects. The projects they infected next was infected with a malware people named "CanisterWorm". In extreme summary, CanisterWorm placed stuff in package.json from the infected NPM project. Every new infected NPM project would download malware to the machine that (unsurprisingly) stole your data. TeamPCP seems to have been inspired by the North Korean government, or ALPHV ransomware group, because instead of stealing data to their server they store it on the blockchain ... making it virtually impossible to takedown. LiteLLM takes place somewhere between Trivy and CanisterWorm. As of this writing the exact way TeamPCP got access to LiteLLM is unknown, however it's heavily speculated it is from Trivy. TeamPCP also stated very bluntly they got access from Trivy but ... they could also be lying. This may come as a surprise, but sometimes criminals lie to cover their tracks. LiteLLM infection though was a few more degrees amplified than the previous stuff. LiteLLM infection also attempts lateral movement by automating Kubernetes stuff. LiteLLM infection also steals a ton more data than previous stuff. Here is the big ass list of stuff it steals: - SSH keys - AWS credentials and configurations - GCP credentials and configurations - Azure environment variables - Kubernetes credentials and configurations - Environment configurations - Shell History - Git credentials and configurations - Docker credentials and configurations - Database instances - IaC / CI/DI - SSL private keys - Solana keys - Crypto wallets - VPN credentials and configurations - Hashicorp vault (?) - NPM configurations - SMTP credentials TeamPCP is unironically putting in big moves. What makes them unusual is how profoundly aggressive they are. It isn't uncommon for Threat Actors to attempt things like this, but TeamPCP is doing something more akin to "smash and grab" rather than "stay silent and watch".

गौरवशाली नेतृत्व के 8,934 दिन… नाम, नरेन्द्र दामोदरदास मोदी! लगभग 25 वर्षों की जनसेवा की इस यात्रा में एक ही संकल्प स्पष्ट दिखता है — नया भारत, मजबूत भारत। साल 2001 में गुजरात के मुख्यमंत्री पद की शपथ के साथ ही नवनिर्माण का सफर शुरू हुआ। गुजरात विकास की ऐसी मिसाल बना, जिसने पूरे देश को नई दिशा दी। “गुजरात मॉडल” केवल एक शब्द नहीं, बल्कि तेज विकास और दृढ़ नेतृत्व का प्रतीक बन गया। 2014 में जब देश ने मोदी जी को अपने प्रधानसेवक के रूप में चुना, तभी से भारत ने एक नए युग में कदम रखा — जनकल्याण, विकास और आत्मनिर्भरता का युग। गरीब कल्याण से लेकर डिजिटल क्रांति तक, आर्थिक विकास से लेकर स्वच्छ और स्वस्थ भारत तक, इंफ्रास्ट्रक्चर से लेकर वैश्विक नेतृत्व तक — हर क्षेत्र में भारत ने नई ऊंचाइयों को छुआ है। आज भारत वैश्विक मंच पर केवल भाग नहीं लेता, बल्कि नेतृत्व करता है। ये 8,934 दिन सिर्फ समय नहीं… एक परिवर्तन, एक विश्वास और एक नए भारत की कहानी है। 🇮🇳 #PradhanSevakModi Video

They highlight that Indian exporters — especially farmers and SMEs — must align with stringent EU requirements on food safety, sustainability and environmental and labour standards. گئی تھیں۔ وہاں ایسے کمرے موجود تھے جو ان چھوٹے بچوں کی لاشوں سے بھرے ہوئے تھے جنہیں دیواروں پر پٹخ کر ہلاک کیا گیا تھا۔ ہزاروں افراد کو قتل کر کے لاشیں دریاؤں میں پھینک دی گئیں اور نسل کش عناصر کشتیوں IBC (Insolvency and Bankruptcy Code) कानून में मोदी सरकार ने 2016 में संशोधन किया, संशोधन के बाद से 2026 तक देश के तमाम उद्योगपति विदेश में पैसा लेकर चले गए। मेरा सवाल है कि संशोधन करके इतना ही सख्त कानून बनाया था, तो तमाम उद्योगपति गरीबों का पैसा लेकर विदेश कैसे चले गए? दिवाला और शोधन अक्षमता संहिता (संशोधन) विधेयक 2025 हमारी दिवाला प्रणाली को जटिल और केंद्रीकृत बनाने का विधेयक है। जिस IBC को सरल, पारदर्शी और समयबद्ध समाधान के लिए बनाया गया था, उस मूल भावना को ये संशोधन कमजोर करता है। इस बिल में सरकार को अधिकार दिया गया है कि वो राजपत्र के माध्यम से नियमों में बदलाव कर सकती है। इसका मतलब है कि संसद को दरकिनार कर कार्यपालिका खुद नियम बना सकती है। इस विधेयक में कर्मचारियों, मजदूरों, ऑपरेशनल ट्रेडर्स के हितों को अनदेखा किया गया है और बैंक, वित्तीय संस्थाओं को प्राथमिकता दी गई है। : लोकसभा में 'दिवाला और शोधन अक्षमता संहिता (संशोधन) विधेयक 2025' पर @bhajanlaljatav जी का पूरा वक्तव्य- Video

I welcome Pakistan’s timely and constructive offer to host dialogue between the United States and Iran. I commend Prime Minister Shehbaz Sharif and the leaders of other friendly nations for stepping forward at a moment of acute regional danger, following the earlier commendable efforts of the leadership of Oman and other friendly countries. Pakistan’s relationships with the relevant parties, and its standing as a credible voice in the Muslim world, place it in a strong position to help create the conditions for meaningful negotiations. Malaysia supports this initiative and encourages in particular the United States and Iran to respond in the spirit in which it was offered. I note with cautious hope the signals, however incomplete, that suggest some space for diplomacy may still exist. That space should be treated with the seriousness it deserves. Any negotiation must proceed on the basis of genuine intent: a clear commitment to ending the conflict, not managing its tempo for tactical advantage. The international community has seen too many ceasefires that function as pauses rather than conclusions. The region deserves something more durable. Malaysia reaffirms Iran’s right to defend its sovereignty, as recognised under international law, particularly in the face of continued Israeli strikes in the country and in Lebanon. At the same time, we call on all parties to exercise maximum restraint and to ensure that civilian populations and the infrastructure of neighbouring states, namely the Gulf states, are not drawn further into a conflict they did not choose. The Gulf states, the region and the world have much at stake — economically, socially and in terms of long-term stability — and their peoples must not bear the consequences of decisions taken elsewhere. It is also a matter of concern that some of the strongest advocates of the rules-based international order appear to apply it unevenly. International law cannot be invoked selectively. It cannot shield one party from accountability while denying another its inherent right to self-defence. Its credibility depends on consistency. In recent days, I have held discussions with leaders of the Gulf Cooperation Council, Türkiye, Egypt, Indonesia, Japan, Pakistan and other partners to better understand the situation and to advocate for de-escalation. Malaysia will continue to support every credible effort towards a just and lasting peace. Thank you. ANWAR IBRAHIM Video

State Workshop on Transformative Social Welfare and Development held in Lucknow A State Workshop on Transformative Social Welfare and Development was successfully held on 24th March 2026 in Lucknow, bringing together key stakeholders to deliberate on strengthening governance and service delivery. Shri Manoj Kumar Singh, CEO, State Transformation Commission (STC), Government of Uttar Pradesh, delivered the welcome address and set the context for the workshop. Shri Rajeev Singh Thakur, Programme Director, Governance & Reforms, NITI Aayog, delivered a special address highlighting the importance of governance reforms, convergence, and institutional strengthening for effective social welfare delivery. Shri Rohit Kumar, Additional Secretary & Mission Director, Aspirational Districts & Blocks Programme (ADP/ABP), NITI Aayog delivered the Opening Remarks, emphasizing the importance of Aspirational Approach, data-driven governance, real-time monitoring, and outcome-based implementation to accelerate development at the grassroots level. Dr. Neelam Patel, Programme Director, Agriculture Technology, NITI Aayog, presented key findings from the DBT study conducted across select districts of Uttar Pradesh, highlighting insights to strengthen last-mile delivery and improve targeting and efficiency of welfare schemes. Deliberations highlighted the need for convergence, innovation, and strengthening last-mile delivery mechanisms. #DidYouKnow Gujarat strengthened transparency and efficiency in its mining sector by introducing a competitive, technology-driven e-auction system for minor mineral blocks. With the introduction of the Gujarat Minor Mineral Concession Rules, 2017 and a dedicated e-auction portal, the State streamlined lease allocation, widened investor participation, and ensured clear timelines. Within less than 2 years, 132 blocks had been successfully auctioned, generating over ₹2,100 crore in revenue - a significant increase over the previous system. The auctions also saw strong competition, averaging over 7 bidders per block, including several new entrants to the sector. The reform improved transparency, boosted revenue, accelerated allotment, and created new employment opportunities. These achievements have been documented as Best Practices on the NITI for States (NFS) Knowledge Portal - an initiative under the State Support Mission. STORY | 'He is in a happy place now': Harish Rana's last rites conducted, family to donate his eyes Bidding farewell to their son one last time, the parents of Harish Rana, the first person in India permitted passive euthanasia, reflected on his life, describing him as a good son as they mourned during his last rites. Harish's mother Nirmala Devi bid an emotional farewell to her son with folded hands and met those present, while his father Ashok Rana urged mourners not to cry, saying his son was in a "happy place now" and had been a good son, a neighbour told PTI over the phone. Harish's last rites were conducted at the Green Park cremation ground in South Delhi on Wednesday morning, marking a quiet end to his 13-year medical ordeal. Family members, along with representatives of the Brahma Kumaris, a spiritual movement led by women, attended the cremation to offer their prayers for Harish. Residents from the Raj Empire Society in Ghaziabad, where the Rana family lives, also came to show their support, joining a diverse group of NGOs, AIIMS staff, relatives, and friends. Sister Lovely of the Brahma Kumaris, who has been associated with the family and travelled to the cremation ground, said that meditative chants were performed during the last rites. "The body is leaving the mortal world, but the soul is immortal and has begun a new journey," she said. "The family decided to donate Harish's eyes," Sister Lovely told PTI. केंद्रीय कर्मचार‍ियों के लि‍ए गुड न्‍यूज, आज हो सकता है डीए हाइक का ऐलान; क‍ितना होगी बढ़ोतरी? अगर आप भी केंद्रीय कर्मचारी हैं या पेंशनर हैं तो यह खबर आपके काम की है. जी हां, प्रधानमंत्री नरेंद्र मोदी की अध्‍यक्षता में होने वाली कैब‍िनेट मीट‍िंग में आज जनवरी-जून 2026 के लिए महंगाई भत्‍ते और महंगाई राहत (DA / DR) बढ़ोतरी का ऐलान क‍िया जा सकता है. अगर मंजूरी म‍िल गई तो इस बढ़ोतरी से कर्मचार‍ियों को महंगाई से राहत म‍िलने की उम्‍मीद है. सरकार की तरफ से हर बार डीए (DA) का ऐलान मार्च के महीने में होली के आसपास क‍िया जाता है. साल 2025 में भी मार्च के आख‍िरी हफ्ते में 28 तारीख को डीए / डीआर का ऐलान हुआ था. ऐसे में आज की मीट‍िंग में भी डीए हाइक का ऐलान होने की उम्‍मीद की जा रही है. महंगाई के आंकड़ों के आधार पर उम्‍म्मीद की जा रही है सरकार की तरफ से इस बार डीए में 2 प्रत‍िशत का इजाफा क‍िया जा सकता है. अभी डीए 58 प्रत‍िशत है, ज‍िसके डीए बढ़ने के बाद 60 प्रत‍िशत होने की उम्‍मीद है. लेबर ब्‍यूरो की तरफ से जारी ऑल इंड‍िया कंज्‍यूमर प्राइस इंडेक्स (CPI-IW) के दिसंबर 2025 का आंकड़ा 148.2 रहा. इसके आधार पर डीए को कैलकुलेट करें तो यह 60.34 प्रतिशत बनता है. ऐसे में यही उम्‍मीद है क‍ि डीए बढ़कर 60 प्रतिशत हो सकता है. . . डीए की कैलकुलेशन पूरी तरह फॉर्मूले पर बेस्‍ड होती है. सरकार र‍िटेल महंगाई दर को CPI-IW इंडेक्स से ट्रैक करती है. इसमें 12 महीने का एवरेज ल‍िया जाता है और उसी के आधार पर डीए की कैलकुलेशन की जाती है. डीए और डीआर हाइक का मकसद कर्मचार‍ियों व पेंशनर्स को महंगाई के असर से बचाना है. यही कारण है क‍ि डीए को साल में दो बार जनवरी और जुलाई के महीने से लागू क‍िया जाता है. 2 प्रतिशत की बढ़ोतरी से कर्मचार‍ियों की मंथली सैलरी और पेंशन में साफ अंतर द‍िखाई देता है. डीए बढ़ने से कर्मचार‍ियों की खरीद करने की क्षमता बनी रहती है. इस बार का डीए हाइक इसल‍िए भी खास है क्‍योंक‍ि सातवें वेतन आयोग का टाइम पीर‍ियड 31 द‍िसंबर 2025 को खत्‍म हो चुका है. #DA #DAHike

The world in which Europe’s modern energy architecture was formed no longer exists. Today, energy systems must be assessed based on their resilience, speed of recovery, and ability to operate under prolonged shocks. Emphasized this during the European Forum at #CERAWeek in Houston, USA. Ukraine has faced these challenges earlier than most. Outlined the following key conclusions to our partners: 📌 Security and protection of energy infrastructure must be integrated into system design from the outset 📌 Distributed generation, cogeneration, energy storage, and backup solutions for critical infrastructure are essential to ensure uninterrupted operation 📌 Diversification strengthens energy independence and reduces systemic risks 📌 Strategic reserves of critical equipment must become an integral element of collective energy security 📌 The role of energy ministers in partner countries should be strengthened, with adequate authority and access to resources. Ukraine’s experience has clear practical value, and we stand ready to share it to enhance energy security across Europe. _____ Світ, у якому формувалася сучасна енергетична архітектура Європи, більше не існує. Сьогодні енергетичні системи слід оцінювати за стійкістю, швидкістю відновлення та здатністю працювати в умовах тривалих шоків. На цьому наголосив під час «Європейського форуму» в межах CERAWeek, що проходить в Х'юстоні, США. Україна була змушена зіткнутися з цими викликами раніше за більшість. Окреслив партнерам наші ключові висновки: 📌 Безпека і захист енергооб’єктів мають бути закладені в проєктування. 📌 Розподілена генерація, когенерація, системи накопичення та резервні рішення для критичної інфраструктури — необхідність, яка забезпечує безперебійність роботи. 📌 Диверсифікація — це про посилення енергонезалежності й зменшення ризиків для енергосистем. 📌 Стратегічні резерви обладнання — це ключовий актив, який має стати частиною колективної енергетичної безпеки. 📌 Роль міністрів енергетики у країнах-партнерах має бути підвищена — з відповідними повноваженнями та доступом до ресурсів. Досвід України має практичну цінність. Ми готові ділитися ним заради зміцнення енергетичної безпеки в Європі.

In its latest State of the Global Climate report, @WMO shows that 2015–2025 were the hottest 11 years on record, with heat stress affecting people of all ages on every continent. Workers are especially vulnerable: around one-third of the global workforce (1.2 billion people) is exposed to workplace heat risk each year. Rising temperatures affect health in many ways, increasing fatigue, injuries, dehydration, kidney strain and mental stress. According to @Lancet Countdown data, heat-related deaths have surged by 63% since the 1990s. As a driver of our warming world, climate change also amplifies public health risks such as vector- and water-borne diseases. @WHO works closely with @WMO to address the impacts of climate change on health systems—including extreme heat—by strengthening health facility readiness to cope with higher temperatures. @WHO calls on governments to ensure that heat early warning systems are tailored to the needs of the health sector and that climate information is integrated into health decision-making. Every heat-related death is preventable.

Ch Fawad Hussain (@fawadchaudhry) Official Statement: National Dialogue Committee (NDC) Subject: Commendation of Pakistan’s Leadership in Mediating West Asia Peace ISLAMABAD — The National Dialogue Committee (NDC) hereby issues this formal commendation of the Government of Pakistan and its military leadership for their proactive and visionary role in de-escalating the ongoing crisis in West Asia. The NDC recognizes that the offer to host "meaningful and conclusive" peace talks in Islamabad represents a watershed moment for Pakistani diplomacy. By leveraging its unique historical and strategic relationships with both Washington and Tehran, Pakistan has positioned itself as the indispensable bridge for regional stability. The Committee emphasizes the following points: • Praise for National Leadership: We applaud Prime Minister Shehbaz Sharif and Chief of Army Staff General Asim Munir for their tireless "back-channel" diplomacy. Their ability to engage with the Trump administration and the Iranian leadership simultaneously reflects a sophisticated balancing of national and global interests. • The Islamabad Venue: We welcome the proposal to make Islamabad the center of these historic negotiations. This initiative restores Pakistan’s standing as a pivotal state capable of facilitating peace in the face of unprecedented global volatility. • Call for Global Cooperation: The NDC expresses its profound hope that the United States, our Arab brothers, and the Islamic Republic of Iran will seize this opportunity. We urge all parties to approach the Islamabad Mediation with a spirit of compromise to reach a comprehensive agreement that ensures long-term security and economic recovery for the region. • Impact on Stability: We believe that an end to the West Asia conflict is not only a moral imperative but a prerequisite for addressing the energy and economic challenges currently facing the Pakistani people. Pakistan remains committed to the principle that dialogue, not conflict, is the only path to a sustainable future. The National Dialogue Committee stands in full support of the state's efforts to bring peace to the Ummah and the world at large. — http://nitter.perennialte.ch/fawadchaudhry/status/2036683836466336148#m

I rise to object to the introduction of the Foreign Contribution (Regulation) Amendment Bill, 2026: ⦿ The State takeover of NGO assets amounts to quasi-expropriation and the proposed Bill centralizes significant powers in the hands of the Central Government by allowing it to determine timelines for the use of foreign contributions, regulate the management of assets and exercise control over various aspects of NGO functioning. ⦿ Experts in policy have observed that the amendment may further shrink the democratic space available to civil society organizations. ⦿ NGOs engaged in human rights, tribal welfare, public health and education are likely to face heightened scrutiny, regulatory uncertainty and fear of punitive action. ⦿ While foreign contributions to NGOs are subjected to stringent controls, foreign direct investment in the corporate sector continues under relatively liberal frameworks. ⦿ This adversely impacts the charitable work of vulnerable communities and affects religious and minority institutions. These concerns have been raised by various religious and charitable organizations, including church bodies, regarding the potential impact of the amendments on faith-based institutions. : Adv. The NDC recognizes that the offer to host "meaningful and conclusive" peace talks in Islamabad represents a watershed moment for Pakistani diplomacy. By leveraging its unique historical and strategic relationships with both Washington and Tehran, Pakistan has positioned itself as the indispensable bridge for regional stability. The Committee emphasizes the following points: • Praise for National Leadership: We applaud Prime Minister Shehbaz Sharif and Chief of Army Staff General Asim Munir for their tireless "back-channel" diplomacy. Their ability to engage with the Trump administration and the Iranian leadership simultaneously reflects a sophisticated balancing of national and global interests. • The Islamabad Venue: We welcome the proposal to make Islamabad the center of these historic negotiations. This initiative restores Pakistan’s standing as a pivotal state capable of facilitating peace in the face of unprecedented global volatility. • Call for Global Cooperation: The NDC expresses its profound hope that the United States, our Arab brothers, and the Islamic Republic of Iran will seize this opportunity. We urge all parties to approach the Islamabad Mediation with a spirit of compromise to reach a comprehensive agreement that ensures long-term security and economic recovery for the region. • Impact on Stability: We believe that an end to the West Asia conflict is not only a moral imperative but a prerequisite for addressing the energy and economic challenges currently facing the Pakistani people. Pakistan remains committed to the principle that dialogue, not conflict, is the only path to a sustainable future. The National Dialogue Committee stands in full support of the state's efforts to bring peace to the Ummah and the world at large. आज देश गंभीर स्वास्थ्य संकट का सामना कर रहा है। Indian Council of Medical Research के अनुसार देश में करीब 10 करोड़ लोग मधुमेह से पीड़ित हैं। National Family Health Survey के अनुसार भारत में हर चौथा वयस्क मोटापे से ग्रसित है। हमारे देश में समझने योग्य पोषक जानकारी का अभाव है, खाद्य पदार्थों पर जानकारी तो दी जाती है, लेकिन वो पैकेट के पीछे छोटे अक्षरों में और जटिल भाषा में दी जाती है। यदि पैकेट के सामने ही लाल-पीला-हरा रंग ये बता दे कि इसमें कौन सा तत्व अधिक या कम है, तो कोई भी व्यक्ति आसानी से समझ सकता है। हमारी मांग है- ⦁ पैकेज्ड फूड में स्पष्ट और प्रभावी नीति की आवश्यकता है ⦁ पैकेट के सामने स्पष्ट और बड़े अक्षरों में जानकारी हो ⦁ खाने के पैकेट पर color coated चेतावनी प्रणाली हो इससे खाद्य कंपनियों की जवाबदेही सुनिश्चित होगी, लोगों के स्वास्थ्य पर सकारात्मक प्रभाव होगा। : राज्यसभा में @Ranjeet4India जी Video

An immediate end to Israeli strikes on Hezbollah. Full lifting of all sanctions with binding economic guarantees. Massive war reparations. Zero restrictions on Iran’s missile programme. And ships paying fees to Iran for passage through the Strait of Hormuz. A US official called the demands “ridiculous and unrealistic.” MBS has been calling Trump privately and consistently throughout the conflict urging him to “keep hitting the Iranians hard.” The NYT reports that the Crown Prince views Epic Fury as a “historic opportunity to remake the region by destroying Iran’s government.” Gulf foreign ministers say patience is “not unlimited.” Saudi Arabia, the UAE, Kuwait, and Bahrain are not asking for a ceasefire. They are asking the United States to crush the regime while the window is open. Two forces pull Trump in opposite directions. Iran says: close your bases, lift all sanctions, pay reparations, keep our missiles. MBS says: keep striking, destroy the government, seize the moment. The 15-point plan demands zero enrichment. Iran demands inalienable rights. The Gulf demands regime destruction. Trump demands a deal he can announce from Graceland. These positions do not intersect. They occupy separate geometric planes that share no common point. And beneath the demands is a paradox that neither side will acknowledge. Iran depends on the Gulf states it is attacking. The UAE is Iran’s primary sanctions-evasion hub. Bilateral trade exceeded $27 billion before the war. Iranian fuel oil exports to the UAE account for roughly 70 percent of Iran’s total fuel oil trade. Shadow fleet networks using UAE-registered companies move Iranian crude to Chinese refineries. The country that is launching drones at Kuwait’s airport fuel tanks and firing missiles at Bahrain is simultaneously relying on Dubai’s free zones to bypass the sanctions that its missile programme provoked. Iran attacks the lifeline it cannot replace. The shared gas field is the physical embodiment of this paradox. The North Field and South Pars are one geological formation, 1,800 trillion cubic feet of natural gas straddling the maritime boundary between Qatar and Iran. Israel struck South Pars on March 18. Iran retaliated against Ras Laffan on the same day. Both sides damaged the same rock. Qatar’s 17 percent LNG capacity loss and Iran’s gas halt to Turkey both originate from strikes on opposite ends of a single reservoir. The world’s largest gas field is now offline on both shores because two belligerents attacked each other’s access to a resource they share. Iran demands reparations for damage to South Pars. Qatar demands reparations for damage to Ras Laffan. Both claims reference the same geological structure. The molecules trapped inside that structure do not know which side of the median line they belong to. They know that both exits are damaged and neither government can extract them until the war ends and the machines that Veron described, the ASUs and the BAHX exchangers built in five workshops with three-year lead times, are manufactured, shipped through a reopened strait, and commissioned in a demilitarised zone. The demands are maximalist. The reactions are dismissive. The shared field is damaged on both sides. The UAE trade hub is under drone fire. The pause expires Saturday. And the molecules of gas, oil, nitrogen, and political capital remain trapped inside a rock, a strait, and a set of contradictions that no 15-point plan can resolve because the geometry of the demands has no solution. The clocks tick. Saturday arrives. The rock does not negotiate. open.substack.com/pub/shanak…
